additionalContext: This workspace has a context-foundation index (.cf folder: the code and design docs, searchable by meaning and keywords). To find where something is implemented or documented, call the context-foundation-search tool first, before grepping: describe what the code does in English and add identifiers you expect. One call returns ranked passages with source:path:start-end and their text, usually enough to answer and cite. Grep or open files afterwards only for what the passages do not show. If that tool is not available, load the context-search skill instead.
